description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

description.zh: 应用集合。以 "," 分割应用 id
description.en: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
全链路灰度模式：

- 0: 按请求内容路由

- 1: 按比例路由
description.en:
The canary release mode.

- 0: Content-based routing

- 1: Proportional routing

description.zh: 已废弃，是否开启数据库灰度。
description.en: This parameter is deprecated. Specifies whether to enable canary release for databases.

description.zh: 泳道组ID。-1时为创建泳道组，大于0时为修改指定泳道组。
description.en: The ID of the lane group. If you set this parameter to -1, a lane group is created. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 0, the specified lane group is modified.
The side for message filtering in a canary release.
Specifies whether to enable canary release for messages.
The name of the lane group.
The name of the MSE namespace.

description.zh: 已废弃，java网关为入口时填写该参数
description.en: This parameter is deprecated. This parameter is used when a Java gateway is the entry application.

description.zh: 是否开启记录请求详情。
description.en: Specifies whether to record the details of canary release requests.

description.zh: 路由ID列表（以云原生网关为入口时，在创建泳道组的泳道前，需调用本接口传入选择的云原生网关路由ID列表）
description.en: The list of route IDs. If a cloud-native gateway is used as the entry application, you must call this operation to pass the list of route IDs for the cloud-native gateway before you create a lane for the lane group.

description.zh: 取值为0表示未生效，取值为1表示生效。
description.en: Specifies whether the lane group is enabled. A value of 0 indicates that the lane group is disabled. A value of 1 indicates that the lane group is enabled.

description.zh: 全链路灰度版本，取值范围：0（不推荐使用，需要指定路由）,2(推荐使用，无需指定路由)
description.en: The version of the end-to-end canary release. Valid values: 0 and 2. A value of 0 is not recommended because you must specify a route. A value of 2 is recommended because you do not need to specify a route.

title.zh: 创建或者更新全链路灰度泳道组

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-or-update-swimming-lane-group --biz-region cn-shanghai --namespace default --id 120 --name group1 --status 0 --entry-app mse-gw:gw-2b1407e050f1446xxxcd2a65fd9xxxx --app-ids xxxxn1po62@492b8f98d4bxxxx,xxxxn1po62@2d8f5d1b7f2xxxx --message-queue-gray-enable true --message-queue-filter-side Server --db-gray-enable true --record-canary-detail false --paths a --route-ids 111 --canary-model 1 --swim-version 2 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse CreateOrUpdateSwimmingLaneGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Status 0 --EntryApp 'mse-gw:gw-2b1407e050f1446xxxcd2a65fd9xxxx' --RouteIds '[111]' --MessageQueueGrayEnable true --CanaryModel 1 --Namespace default --Name group1 --DbGrayEnable true --SwimVersion 2 --Region 'cn-shanghai' --MessageQueueFilterSide Server --AcceptLanguage zh --Id 120 --Paths '["a"]' --RecordCanaryDetail false --AppIds 'xxxxn1po62@492b8f98d4bxxxx,xxxxn1po62@2d8f5d1b7f2xxxx'
